name: Solarized
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Calm, low-glare colours for long reading: Solarized's warm light page by day and its deep blue-green one at night, blue links, cyan and green headings and orange code. On the Solarized palette.

zh.description: 低眩光的平静配色，适合长时间阅读：白天是 Solarized 的暖色浅底，夜里是深蓝绿底，蓝色链接、青绿标题、橙色代码。基于 Solarized 配色。
